title: PACT Parley Accept Request
description: Request body for POST /api/pact/parleys/{parleyId}/accept. Carries the accepting participant's Mandate, whose parley_id MUST equal the Parley being joined (20.5 step 7). Atomic: either the participant is in WITH a verified Mandate, or not in at all — there is no 'joined but unmandated' state. Added in PACT v2.1 (Section 19.5).

invite.description: The invite credential from peer_invite_url, where the implementation carries it in the body rather than the query string.
